positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
• Led team working on internal tools to increase developer experience, focusing on pre-production qualification velocity.
• Owned, designed, and led team to build a centralized service managing all testing hardware at EBS. Features include capacity management, health monitoring, telemetry, and configuration.
• Performed as team’s "gov cloud" operations engineer in datacenters reserved for government use.
• Conducted interviews for EBS industry hiring and AWS Student Programs.
positions.insights: Amazon Redshift, Distributed Systems and +26 skills

positions.title: SDE
positions.description: • Created a fully automated, end-to-end testing platform for all releases within the Elastic Block Storage (EBS) offering at AWS. Platform includes a full suite of performance and fault injection qualifications, cutting weeks of engineering hours from every release. Platform orchestrated thousands of EC2 instances driving millions of IOPS.
positions.insights: Amazon Redshift, Distributed Systems and +25 skills

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
• Engineering advisor turned CTO to a medtech startup started at UPenn Nursing. 
• Won cash grant as runner-up in UPenn Nursing Innovation Accelerator program out of 16 teams. Accelerator was supported by several Philadelphia VCs and the Children's Hospital of Pennsylvania.
• Designed and developed a POC for a child-safe wearable with anti-elopement safety features via ultra-wideband (UWB) indoor location tracking with centimeter level accuracy.
positions.insights: Indoor Positioning Systems, Hardware Virtualization and +17 skills
